selected_evidence.requirement: Container runs as unprivileged appsvc account
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc created as uid 995 with no shell login; podman/systemctl commands executed as appsvc via sudo -u appsvc; webapp.service cgroup shows path user-995.slice/user@995.service, and container process tree runs under that slice.
curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 both during manual smoke test and after starting via the systemd unit; podman ps shows 0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp mapping.

selected_evidence.requirement: Starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger appsvc set Linger=yes; user@995.service is active with 'No sessions' in loginctl list-sessions; webapp.service confirmed as a dependency of appsvc's default.target via systemctl --user list-dependencies.
Captured baseline boot_id c2ffc729-a31e-486e-95de-cf2023dea95c, confirmed webapp.service active and HTTP 200 prior to reboot.
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' returned pid immediately (reboot triggered pid 11609) before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart confirmed via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Immediately after reboot trigger, exec timed out (node down); subsequent poll succeeded with boot_id 04202496-7eea-43c9-9716-78ce8ad58f70, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: service, data, and no-login-session condition all restored
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot: uptime shows fresh boot time (22:57:16), loginctl reports 'No sessions' and State=lingering for appsvc, webapp.service is active, podman ps shows a freshly started container (new container ID, 7s uptime), and curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200.
